facts.value: Constructs a demo-context Fighter GObj with pooled Fighter and attribute-backup storage, unload/render callbacks, character and costume setup, selected inclusive motion-data intervals, subsystem initialization, and five scheduled fighter processes. After optional creation-callback dispatch, ftLib_800867E8 resets input and sets Fighter.x221D_b4=true, then the constructor returns the GObj. The final helper is not fighter-library registration.
facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline registration interpretation using the canonical final callee.

evidence.why: Final helper resets input and sets the flag.
Active consumer establishes inclusive motion-data traversal.

facts.value: The allocation descriptor supplies internal_id, slot, and has_transformation to a local plAllocInfo adapter, with has_transformation mapped to the adapter's b0. The local temp1 is declared without an initializer and its s8 x5 member is not assigned; Fighter_UnkInitLoad_80068914 actively reads that uninitialized member into Fighter.x61C. This source-level indeterminate-value transfer has no established default, compiled value, target consequence or downstream significance here. The separate plAllocInfo2.b0 selects a costume-resource path. Initialized Fighter kind selects motion, effect, and callback tables; unk8 selects inclusive motion-data bounds and the final creation callback. Fighter state is attached as GObj user data with an unload callback. Following subsystem/process setup, ftLib_800867E8 resets input and sets x221D_b4. Player callers store the returned GObj in entity slots.
facts.rationale: Preserves the supported two-b0 and final-call corrections while repairing the omitted active read of uninitialized adapter x5.

evidence.why: Partial descriptor initialization, allocations, selection and ordering.
plAllocInfo contains the separate s8 x5 member.
Initialization callee reads argdata->x5 into Fighter.x61C.

facts.value: Stages an archive public-address pointer only while ftData_UnkIntPairs[pairs_idx].data is null. A populated entry suppresses name generation and lookup even if archive or arr_idx changes; a null result permits retry. This is not a permanently write-once cache: ftData_80085B98 consumes the staged base into selected motion-entry addresses and clears the shared pointer, permitting later staging. This helper does not copy or free the backing payload.
facts.rationale: The active cross-file consumer establishes the missing lifecycle.

evidence.why: Null guard and direct pointer assignment.

facts.value: Writes the requested float to Fighter.facing_dir and requests Y rotation M_PI_2 times that value for part 0 through ftPartSetRotY. The helper uses the primary joint or, for a quaternion primary, alternate x4_jobj2, asserting if both use quaternion rotation. No normalization, finite-value guard, or rollback of the preceding facing-field write is performed.
facts.rationale: Replaces unverified root naming with proved part identity and downstream behavior.

evidence.why: Field write, coefficient expression and part index.

facts.value: Player allocation descriptors select fighter identity, slot/transformation initialization, costume branch, inclusive motion-data interval, and creation callback for a newly allocated Fighter GObj. The private adapter assigns only internal_id, slot and b0 in local plAllocInfo temp1; its s8 x5 remains uninitialized and Fighter_UnkInitLoad_80068914 reads it into Fighter.x61C. This source-level indeterminate-value transfer does not establish a default or compiled value; target consequences and downstream significance remain unresolved. Archive selectors stage public-symbol payload addresses in per-kind ftData entries; ftData_80085B98 derives selected motion-entry addresses and clears the staged base. Facing input updates Fighter.facing_dir and requests Y rotation for part 0. Construction ends with input reset and x221D_b4=true through ftLib_800867E8, not library registration.
facts.rationale: Preserves staging, part-zero and final-call corrections while repairing the TU-wide omission of the active uninitialized adapter-member read.

evidence.why: Owned data flow and partial local adapter initialization.
Separate s8 x5 member in plAllocInfo.
